items.title: Mrs. Robert George (Mary) Hoffman Interview, 1976-02-05
items.q: But anyway, he engaged me to sing at this dinner.

ctx.x: That must have been right before it burned. It was.

It was almost immediately before. Now this is, this is a little interesting thing. There was a, um, a lawyer in this town named Mr. W. O. Hart. I think his name is on this. And they had a Constitutional Convention dinner. See, reunion and banquet of members of the Constitutional Convention in the years. And it was in the gold room of the Grunewald Hotel, May the 22nd, 1915. And Mr. Hart knew, I don't, I don't even know how he knew or thought I could sing or what. But anyway, he engaged me to sing at this dinner.…
I see it in the city of New Orleans.
